regions.note: A motif, not a reproduction of the source's bespoke diagram.

invariants: Rules BETWEEN bands, never around them. Four bordered cards read as four separate things; shared rules say these classes divide one whole, which is what a taxonomy claims.
The class name never shares a line with its members. The source runs two of its four classes straight through their own text.
Three to five classes. Two is a comparison; six stops exhausting anything a reader can hold.
The art slot takes a motif only. A template cannot carry someone else's one-off infographic, and pretending it can is how a kit fills with diagrams nobody reuses.
